Th e clinician will use this information to rule out any possible
ﬂ uid and electrolyte disorders. Th is information will be con-

Fluid and electrolyte assessment is not as easy as it may seem—
many disorders produce clinical manifestations that are vague
and that often overlap each other. With experience, however, 
the clinician will become proﬁ cient in assessment of ﬂ uid and
electrolyte balance.
